The squares sew in drawing order (x 0, 50, 25); the exit of each square and the entry of the next are on the facing corners (jumps 40.0 and 15.0 mm). Black-box tests of the command (gui-optimize-findings in the track notes): with or without the option, Optimize Sewing Order keeps drawing order within a colour, groups colours (red 0, blue 50, red 25 became red 0, red 25, blue 50), and links entry/exit only between same-colour neighbours. Round 1 (PR #34) made the same design with under sewing on: same order, gaps 41.3 and 16.3 mm, because the under sewing starts 1 mm inside the outline.
